description: This file contains shell script functions used for network interface configuration and management in the OpenWrt platform, including functions for finding configurations, calling ubus, fixing interface parameters, scanning and preparing interfaces, setting up interfaces, and executing sysctl commands.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds network interface configuration based on device name

methods.name: unbridge
methods.description: Placeholder function for unbridging interfaces (no operation)

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Wraps ubus call and processes JSON data

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts interface configuration parameters based on current status

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and applies fixup to all interfaces

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Adds a device to a network interface

methods.name: do_sysctl
methods.description: Sets or retrieves system kernel parameters
